coverage.note: A coverage group may contain several required parts. Any-part counts do not prove complete assembly or occlusion.

ball.scaleRule: Uniform XY: current projected r16 horizontal diameter / authored footprint width; no native state offset

planeCollapse.model: one continuous 2D navigation plane inside outer temple walls
planeCollapse.internalWaterChannels: traversable same plane; no water-edge collider or depth simulation
planeCollapse.shortBridgesRampsSteps: same plane; no height layer or elevation-edge collider
planeCollapse.foregroundBasins: receiver region only; four goal triggers
planeCollapse.supportRule: retain only solid support footprints: pillars, frogs, and separate arch feet; no arch-lintel collider in 2D
planeCollapse.unresolved: Whether a chosen physical ball fits under the painted arches is a 2D approximation to be assessed in contact QA, not recovered hidden 3D.

environment.requiredVisualReview: Arch feet, lintel, opening, shore/rail, basins and front rim in available native approaches
